name: revokeAgent
label: Revoke
description: Fully and irreversibly revoke an agent (op:revoke): withdraw its /128, PTR, tokens, and its API key. Returns the agent id and status revoked. A revoke that matches nothing (already revoked, or not your agent) stops with a NOT_FOUND error saying nothing was revoked; do not retry it. Requires admin:dns scope. This cannot be undone.
